entities.name: House-Museum of Sattar Bahlulzade
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Sattar Bahlulzade's House Museum is a house-museum created for Sattar Bahlulzade, one of the most prominent representatives of the Azerbaijani painting school, the Honored Art Worker of Azerbaijan (1960), the People's Artist of Azerbaijan (1963), and the State Prize laureate of the Azerbaijan SSR (1972).
